name: cms
note: CMS Phase-2 step3 with HGCal/TICL, the tracker and the barrel and forward calorimeters: hgcal.json, tracker.json and calo.json joined. HGCalNanoAOD's GeneralTrack has the rows of Tracks (both are generalTracks in order): it is checked and folded into Tracks, which takes over its HGCal entry point (used where a TICL candidate has no trackster), so candidate -> track and track <-> truth relations reach Tracks. Truth particles are drawn as helices; only in-time pile-up is kept (cuts from hgcal.json): particles of bunch crossing 0 and the vertices they are produced in or decay at (at PU200: 105k of 720k particles, 63k of 425k vertices per event). Domains: Tracker (with the field, from tracker.json), Calo (calo.json), then HGCal, its region from the hits of the ttbar samples (r <= 257 cm, 322 <= |z| <= 513 cm).
